# Player Protocol (Client UDP Commands, Player Lifecycle, Versions)

## TL;DR

Player clients send S-expression commands over UDP; a bison/flex parser turns them into `Player` method calls, and the protocol version (1-19) selects a family of serializers and senders.
- **Open the full file when:** you add a player command, change parsing, or add/alter a protocol version.
- Parse path: `Stadium::udp_recv_message` → `Player::parseMsg` → `M_parser.parse()` (bison, `src/player_command_parser.ypp`, `src/player_command_tok.lpp`). Hand-written `parseCommand` is a Cygwin-only fallback.
- Player lifecycle: `Team::newPlayer` → `Player::init(version, goalie)` → `setSenders()` → `connect()` → enabled per cycle.
- Versions: `Player::setSenders()` looks up every sender/serializer factory with `(int)version()`; registrations live in `serializerplayerstdv*.cpp`, `visualsenderplayer.cpp`, `bodysender.cpp`, `fullstatesender.cpp`, `audio.cpp`.
- Coach / online-coach protocols (`rcss/clang/`, `coach.cpp`) are out of scope.

## Overview

A player connects with `(init <team> <version> [goalie])` (see `Stadium::initPlayer`, `src/stadium.cpp` ~L562-634) and then sends action commands (`dash`, `turn`, `kick`, …) and information commands (`sense_body`, `change_view`, `synch_see`, `gaussian_see`, …). The server answers with `(ok …)` and `(error …)` messages and streams observation messages back (see `observation-sensors`).

## Architecture

### Receive and parse
- `Stadium::doRecvFromClients()` (`src/stadium.cpp` ~L2191-2225) → `udp_recv_message()` (~L2579) reads packets and routes them to the owning `Player`.
- `Player::parseMsg(char *msg, size_t len)` (`src/player.cpp` ~L527-555): forces NUL termination (`(warning message_not_null_terminated)` for v8+), logs with `Logger::writePlayerLog` (RECV), then calls `M_parser.parse(command)` (`#ifndef __CYGWIN__`). On failure it sends `(error illegal_command_form)`.
- Grammar: `src/player_command_parser.ypp` (tokens ~L94; `view_quality` ~L117, ~L275; `change_view_com` ~L251; `gaussian_see_com` ~L376-378). Tokenizer: `src/player_command_tok.lpp` (e.g. `gaussian_see` L75). Generated by `bison_target`/`flex_target` in `src/CMakeLists.txt` L2-22; `src/fix_lexer_file.cmake` patches the lexer output.
- The parser calls a builder interface implemented by `Player` (`src/pcombuilder.h`, `src/pcomparser.h/.cpp`, `src/pcombuilder.cpp`; `Player` overrides e.g. `gaussian_see()` in `src/player.h` ~L517).
- `Player::parseCommand()` (`src/player.cpp` ~L557-930) is a sscanf-based fallback used only when `__CYGWIN__` is defined. Keep both paths aligned when adding commands.

### Command handling (builder side)
Action methods are in `src/player.cpp`: `turn` (~L1263), `turn_neck` (~L1280), `change_focus` (~L1292), `kick` (~L1305), `long_kick` (~L1422), `dash` (~L1094), `tackle` (~L2066), `goalieCatch` (~L1523), `move` (~L1728), `say` (~L1704), `sense_body` (~L1716), `pointto` (~L1962), `attentionto` (~L1977), `change_view` (~L1782, ~L1868), `compression` (~L1930), `synch_see` (~L2354), `gaussian_see` (~L2387), `clang` (~L2266), `ear` (~L2287). Detailed semantics: `actions-models`.

Per-cycle command rules use flags: `M_command_done` (one movement command per cycle), `M_turn_neck_done`, and `resetCommandFlags()` (`src/player.cpp` ~L2754) cleared in `Stadium::step`.

### Player lifecycle
- Construction: `Stadium::createObjects()` creates `MAX_PLAYER` players per side (`src/stadium.cpp` ~L539-547). Players start disabled.
- `Team::newPlayer()` → `Player::init(double ver, bool goalie)` (`src/player.cpp` ~L303-372): sets `M_randp` (player_rand × team factor), sets angles, then `setSenders()`. On failure, `disable()` and an error is printed.
- `Stadium::initPlayer()` → `connect(addr)`, `addListener`, `M_remote_players.push_back`, `sendInit()`, `initObservationMode()` (v18+ forces `synch_see`, `src/player.cpp` ~L376-387).
- Reconnect: `Stadium::reconnectPlayer()` (~L638-685) reuses a slot and calls `setSenders()` again.
- `Player::setEnable()` (~L424), `disable()` (~L460), `discard()` (~L495), `changeToGoalie()` (~L512), `substitute(type)` (~L413), `setPlayerType(id)` (~L391).
- `version()` is a double; `setEnforceDedicatedPort(version >= 8.0)` is used on connect (`stadium.cpp` ~L629, ~L676).

### Protocol versions
- `Player::setSenders()` (`src/player.cpp` ~L2439-2524) creates, in this order: `SerializerPlayer`, `BodySenderPlayer`, `VisualSenderPlayer`, `InitSenderPlayer`, `FullStateSenderPlayer`, `AudioSenderPlayer`. Each lookup uses `factory().getCreator(creator, (int)version())`; failure prints `No ... Creator v<version>` and returns false.
- Registrations (exact integer keys via `autoReg`):
  - Serializer: v1-4 `SerializerPlayerStdv1` (`serializerplayerstdv1.cpp` L447-450); v5-6 Stdv5 (L67-68); v7 Stdv7 (L200); v8-12 Stdv8 (L325-329); v13 Stdv13 (L196); v14-17 Stdv14 (L141-144); v18-19 Stdv18 (L132-133).
  - Visual: `visualsenderplayer.cpp` L1329-1347 (v1-3 V1, v4 V4, v5 V5, v6 V6, v7 V7, v8-12 V8, v13-17 V13, v18-19 V18).
  - Body: `bodysender.cpp` L423-441; FullState: `fullstatesender.cpp` L526-544; Audio: `audio.cpp` L970-988.
- Versions below 1 or unregistered integers fail `setSenders()`; `Team::newPlayer` then reports `no_more_player_or_goalie_or_illegal_client_version` (`stadium.cpp` ~L614).
- Version-specific behavior is layered by subclassing (e.g. `SerializerPlayerStdv18` extends the v14 family; `BodySenderPlayerV18` extends `V14` and adds focus point, `bodysender.cpp` ~L396-412).
- Version-gated init params: `ServerParam`/`PlayerParam` `addParam(…, version)` (see `config-params`).

### Quick version map (current)
| Versions | Serializer | Visual sender | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1-4 | Stdv1 | V1 | base protocol, no body direction for v1-3 |
| 5-6 | Stdv5 | V4/V5 | neck angle and body direction |
| 7 | Stdv7 | V5-V7 | |
| 8-12 | Stdv8 | V8 | |
| 13 | Stdv13 | V13 | |
| 14-17 | Stdv14 | V13 | foul and card info in sense_body |
| 18-19 | Stdv18 | V18 | focus point; v18+ forced synch_see; v19 Gaussian available for all |

(Table is a summary of the registrations above; verify exact class chains in `src/visualsenderplayer.h` before relying on it.)

## Patterns & Conventions

- New command: add a grammar rule and token in `player_command_parser.ypp`/`.lpp`, implement the builder method in `Player`, add a `parseCommand` branch for the Cygwin path, and update `pcombuilder.h`.
- Reply conventions: `send("(ok <cmd>)")` for accepted changes (e.g. `synch_see`, `gaussian_see`), `send("(error …)")` for rejection.
- Versions are compared as doubles (`version() >= 8.0`) or as ints in factory lookups.
- Logging of received/sent messages: `Logger::instance().writePlayerLog(...)` with `RECV`/`SEND`.

## Integration Points

- Stadium: `Stadium::initPlayer`, `reconnectPlayer`, `doRecvFromClients`, `doSendVisuals` (`src/stadium.cpp`).
- Sensors: `Player::sendVisual`, `sendSynchVisual`, `sendBody` (via `BodyObserverPlayer`), `sendFullstate` (`src/player.cpp` ~L2413-2436).
- Audio: `Player::say` → `Stadium::sendPlayerAudio` (`stadium.h` L387).
- Config: `ServerParam::instance()` limits (`say_msg_size`, `visible_angle`, ...).

## Build & Test

- Parser generation requires `bison` and `flex` (see `build-system`); a stale `player_command_parser.cpp` will not reflect `.ypp` changes.
- The Cygwin fallback is not compiled on other platforms; test grammar changes with a real client connection.

## Important Notes

- `coach` and `olcoach` commands are processed by `src/coach.cpp` and `rcss/clang/`, not by `Player`. Coach protocol: see `rcss/clang/` (out of scope).
- `Player::parseMsg` always writes a `(error illegal_command_form)` on grammar failure; the hand-written parser may accept inputs the grammar rejects, so keep behavior identical.
- Don't add version checks for old protocols inside `Player`; put them in the serializer/sender subclass.
